concepts.title: 不等式的统一解题法
concepts.summary: 先把不等式写成 $F(x)\gtrless0$。临界点把数轴分段；同一段内符号不变。选对区间，再检查端点。

method.title: 归零与找临界点
method.body: 移项，使右边为 $0$；找分子和分母的全部实数零点。

method.title: 画符号表
method.body: 从小到大排列临界点，每段选一个测试值；也可根据图像在 $x$ 轴的上方或下方判号。

method.title: 选区间与端点
method.body: $>0$ 选正号，$<0$ 选负号；$\ge0$、$\le0$ 可以加入有定义的零点。分母零点永远排除。

pitfalls: 解不等式要找一整段取值，不只是解等式得到的零点。
无穷大不是端点值，区间在无穷大处总用圆括号。

en.title: The Sign Method
en.summary: Write the inequality as $F(x)\gtrless0$. Boundary points divide the number line into intervals with constant sign. Select the required intervals and then check endpoints.

method.title: Move everything to one side
method.body: Put $0$ on the right. Find all real zeros of the numerator and denominator.

method.title: Build a sign chart
method.body: Order the boundary points and test one value in each interval. Alternatively, read whether the graph is above or below the $x$-axis.

method.title: Select intervals and endpoints
method.body: Choose positive intervals for $>0$ and negative intervals for $<0$. For $\ge0$ or $\le0$, include defined zeros. Always exclude denominator zeros.

pitfalls: An inequality asks for intervals, not just the zeros found by solving an equation.
Always use parentheses at infinity.

concepts.title: 多项式不等式
concepts.summary: 多项式在相邻实数零点之间连续且不为零，所以符号保持不变。先因式分解，再判断各段符号。

method.title: 移项并因式分解
method.body: 写成 $P(x)\gtrless0$；先提公因子，再用分组、二次式或有理零点法分解。

method.title: 只找实数临界点
method.body: 解 $P(x)=0$。例如 $x^2+2>0$ 对所有实数成立，不增加临界点。

method.title: 测符号并写区间
method.body: 每段代一个测试值；保留满足要求的区间，按不等号决定是否包含零点。

pitfalls: 没有实数零点的因子仍有正负号；不能随意丢掉负因子。
当 $P(x)\le0$ 或 $P(x)\ge0$ 时，所有多项式零点都满足等号。

en.title: Polynomial Inequalities
en.summary: A polynomial is continuous and nonzero between consecutive real zeros, so its sign is constant on each interval. Factor first and then determine the signs.

method.title: Rearrange and factor
method.body: Write $P(x)\gtrless0$. Use common factors, grouping, quadratic factoring, or rational zeros as needed.

method.title: Find real boundary points
method.body: Solve $P(x)=0$. A factor such as $x^2+2$ is always positive and adds no real boundary point.

method.title: Test signs and state intervals
method.body: Evaluate one test point per interval. Select the required signs and include zeros only for a nonstrict inequality.

pitfalls: A factor with no real zeros still has a sign. Do not discard a negative factor.
Every polynomial zero satisfies $P(x)\le0$ and $P(x)\ge0$.

concepts.title: 重根：什么时候变号
concepts.summary: 在零点 $a$ 附近，奇数次因子 $(x-a)^m$ 变号，偶数次因子不变号。分母的重复因子也遵守同一符号规律，但零点必须排除。

method.title: 标出次数
method.body: 把每个实数临界点的因子次数写出。若分子分母含同一点，先保留原定义域，再综合因子的次数判断符号。

method.title: 从一侧确定符号
method.body: 用一个测试值或首项判断最右段的符号。

method.title: 跨过临界点
method.body: 奇数重数：换号；偶数重数：同号。最后按严格或非严格不等号检查零点。

pitfalls: 偶数重根处图像接触横轴，左右同号。
严格不等式即使零点两侧都满足，也要把该零点挖掉。

en.title: Multiplicity and Sign Changes
en.summary: An odd power $(x-a)^m$ changes sign at $a$; an even power does not. Repeated denominator factors follow the same sign rule, but their zeros remain excluded.

method.title: Identify multiplicities
method.body: Record the power of each factor. If a factor occurs in both numerator and denominator, retain the original domain restriction and account for the net parity.

method.title: Determine one sign
method.body: Use a test point or the leading term to determine the sign on the rightmost interval.

method.title: Move across the boundaries
method.body: Odd multiplicity reverses the sign; even multiplicity preserves it. Then apply the endpoint rules.

pitfalls: At an even-multiplicity zero, the graph touches the axis and keeps the same sign.
A strict inequality excludes a zero even if both neighboring intervals satisfy the inequality.

concepts.title: 有理不等式与分母限制
concepts.summary: 对 $R(x)=N(x)/D(x)$，当 $D(x)\ne0$ 时，商的符号与乘积 $N(x)D(x)$ 相同。分子零点和原分母零点都要划分区间。

method.title: 记录定义域
method.body: 解原分母 $D(x)=0$，记录所有排除值；约分后也不能恢复这些值。

method.title: 分段判号
method.body: 分子、分母分别因式分解，将两者零点按序排在数轴上，每段测试商的符号。

method.title: 按类别处理端点
method.body: 非严格不等式可包含有定义的分子零点；分母零点、垂直渐近线和空洞始终排除。

pitfalls: 分母为零处不能因“等号成立”而加入。
分母为零不一定变号：偶数次因子两侧可同号。

en.title: Rational Inequalities and Domain Restrictions
en.summary: For $R(x)=N(x)/D(x)$ with $D(x)\ne0$, the quotient has the same sign as $N(x)D(x)$. Use both numerator zeros and original denominator zeros as boundary points.

method.title: Record the domain
method.body: Solve $D(x)=0$ using the original denominator. Cancellation never restores these values.

method.title: Determine signs by intervals
method.body: Factor numerator and denominator, order all their real zeros, and test the quotient on each interval.

method.title: Treat endpoints by type
method.body: A nonstrict inequality can include defined numerator zeros. Denominator zeros, vertical asymptotes, and holes are always excluded.

pitfalls: A denominator zero is never an allowed endpoint.
A denominator zero need not reverse the sign; even powers keep the same sign.

concepts.title: 两边都有分式：先归零通分
concepts.summary: 遇到 $A(x)/B(x)\gtrless C(x)/D(x)$ 或分式与常数比较，先移项、通分，得到一个分式与 $0$ 比较。

method.title: 先记限制并移项
method.body: 排除每个原分母零点；把右侧全部减到左侧。

method.title: 通分并整理
method.body: 用最小公分母合并分式，完整展开括号，再因式分解分子和分母。

method.title: 使用符号法
method.body: 找全部临界点，测试各区间，最后按原不等号和原定义域写出答案。

pitfalls: 不要直接乘含 $x$ 的分母：它可能是负数，负数乘除会反转不等号。
通分时减号要作用到整个分子。

en.title: Rearranging Rational Inequalities
en.summary: When comparing two rational expressions or a rational expression with a constant, subtract, combine over a common denominator, and compare one rational expression with $0$.

method.title: Restrict the domain and subtract
method.body: Exclude every original denominator zero, then subtract the right-hand side from the left.

method.title: Combine and factor
method.body: Use a common denominator. Distribute all minus signs, simplify, and factor numerator and denominator.

method.title: Apply the sign method
method.body: Find boundary points, test intervals, and state the solution using the original inequality and domain.

pitfalls: Do not multiply by a variable denominator without separating its possible signs. Multiplication by a negative expression reverses the inequality.
A subtraction sign applies to the entire numerator.

concepts.title: 模型、比较与目标范围
concepts.summary: 把题意翻成不等式，再与情境有效域取交集。若要求 $a\le f(x)\le b$，必须同时满足两条不等式。

method.title: 定义变量与有效域
method.body: 写清变量、单位与物理限制，例如 $t\ge0$、浓度非负或模型限定的区间。

method.title: 建立比较或范围
method.body: “至少”用 $\ge$，“少于”用 $<$；两模型比较用 $f(x)-g(x)\gtrless0$；范围用两条条件。

method.title: 解并解释
method.body: 分别解不等式并取交集；检查端点、单位以及题目要求的有效数字。

pitfalls: 代数答案可能含负时间；最后必须与情境有效域取交集。
范围题是两条条件同时成立，要取交集。

en.title: Applications, Comparisons, and Target Ranges
en.summary: Translate the situation into inequalities and intersect the algebraic solution with the valid model domain. A target band $a\le f(x)\le b$ requires both inequalities.

method.title: Define the variable and domain
method.body: State the variable, units, and restrictions such as $t\ge0$, nonnegative concentration, or a prescribed model interval.

method.title: Translate the requirement
method.body: Use $\ge$ for “at least” and $<$ for “less than.” Compare models through $f(x)-g(x)\gtrless0$. Split a target band into two inequalities.

method.title: Solve and interpret
method.body: Intersect all required solution sets. Check endpoints, units, and the requested rounding.

pitfalls: An algebraic answer can contain negative time. Always impose the model domain.
A target band requires an intersection of two conditions.
en.note: Extension for the application and target-range exercises. The section has no worked application Example.

concepts.note: 教材 Exercises 的应用与范围题补充；正文没有配套应用 Example。

concepts.title: 用不等式求定义域
concepts.summary: 偶次根号内必须 $\ge0$；分母必须 $\ne0$。若偶次根式位于分母，其被开方数必须严格 $>0$。

method.title: 列出全部限制
method.body: 对每个偶次根式写被开方数 $\ge0$；对分母写 $\ne0$。

method.title: 解各个不等式
method.body: 若根号内是分式，用有理不等式符号表；保留原分母的排除点。

method.title: 取交集
method.body: 只有同时满足全部条件的 $x$ 才属于定义域；用区间表示。

pitfalls: $\sqrt{A(x)}$ 可等于零，但 $1/\sqrt{A(x)}$ 不可。
多重限制要取交集，不能取并集。

en.title: Finding Domains with Inequalities
en.summary: An even-root radicand must be $\ge0$ and every denominator must be nonzero. An even root in a denominator therefore requires a strictly positive radicand.

method.title: List every restriction
method.body: Write radicand $\ge0$ for each even root and denominator $\ne0$ for each denominator.

method.title: Solve each restriction
method.body: For a rational radicand, use a rational sign chart and keep the original denominator exclusions.

method.title: Intersect the conditions
method.body: The domain consists of the $x$-values satisfying every restriction. State it in interval notation.

pitfalls: $\sqrt{A(x)}$ may equal zero, but $1/\sqrt{A(x)}$ may not.
Use an intersection when several restrictions apply.
en.note: Extension for the domain exercises, applying the section’s sign method to radical functions.

concepts.note: 教材 Exercises 的定义域应用补充；用于把 2.5 的符号法接到根式函数。

concepts.title: 从解集反推不等式
concepts.summary: 已知想要的解集时，先决定临界点、左右符号和端点是否允许，再选因子的重数与整体正负号。

method.title: 读区间与端点
method.body: 区间分界给出候选因子；需要排除的孤立点可由严格不等式零点或分母限制产生。

method.title: 安排符号变化
method.body: 需换号用奇数次因子；需同号用偶数次因子。分母因子产生禁止点。

method.title: 验证构造
method.body: 选整体常数的正负号与不等号；画符号表检查每段和每个端点。构造题通常不唯一。

pitfalls: 只有区间形状正确还不够，端点的开闭也必须正确。
相同解集可能对应许多不同不等式。

en.title: Constructing Inequalities and Reasoning Backward
en.summary: Given a desired solution set, determine boundary points, neighboring signs, and endpoint inclusion first. Then choose factor multiplicities and the overall sign.

method.title: Read the intervals and endpoints
method.body: Boundary values suggest factors. An excluded point can come from a strict-inequality zero or a denominator restriction.

method.title: Choose sign changes
method.body: Use odd powers to reverse a sign and even powers to preserve it. Denominator factors create excluded points.

method.title: Verify the construction
method.body: Choose the overall sign and inequality symbol. Check all intervals and endpoints with a sign chart. Many constructions are possible.

pitfalls: Both the interval signs and endpoint inclusion must match.
Different inequalities can have the same solution set.
en.note: Extension for the construction, reasoning, and degree exercises.

concepts.note: 教材 Exercises 的构造、论证与次数拓展。

questions.label: 教材 Example 1：多项式不等式

steps.title: 分段
steps.body: 临界点为 $-2,2,3$；数轴分成四段。

steps.title: 选负号并加入零点
steps.body: 要求 $P(x)\le0$，选两段负号，并加入 $-2,2,3$。

en.label: Textbook Example 1: Solve a Polynomial Inequality

steps.title: Divide the number line
steps.body: The boundary points are $-2,2,3$, forming four intervals.

steps.title: Determine the signs
steps.body: At $x=-3,0,2.5,4$, the values are $-30,12,-9/8,12$. The signs are $-,+,-,+$. Each zero has odd multiplicity, so the graph crosses the axis at each one.

steps.title: Select and include endpoints
steps.body: For $P(x)\le0$, choose the negative intervals and include the zeros $-2,2,3$.

steps.title: 选正号与零点
steps.body: 保留 $(-4,-3)$ 和 $(3,\infty)$；非严格不等式加入三个零点。

steps.title: Rearrange
steps.body: Collect terms: $P(x)=x^3+4x^2-9x-36\ge0$.

steps.title: Test the intervals
steps.body: The boundary points are $-4,-3,3$. At $x=-5,-3.5,0,4$, the values are $-16,13/8,-36,56$, giving signs $-,+,-,+$.

steps.title: Select the nonnegative set
steps.body: Choose $(-4,-3)$ and $(3,\infty)$ and include all three zeros because the inequality is nonstrict.

steps.title: 找零点与重数
steps.body: $-3$ 和 $2$ 是一重根，$-1$ 是二重根。

steps.title: 判断图像
steps.body: 首项为 $x^4$，两端向上；一重根处穿过横轴，二重根处只接触横轴。

steps.title: 排除全部零点
steps.body: 选横轴下方的两段。严格不等式排除 $-3,-1,2$；尤其 $-1$ 虽两侧都是负号，也不可加入。

en.label: Textbook Example 2: Using Graphs to Solve a Polynomial Inequality

steps.title: Find zeros and multiplicities
steps.body: $-3$ and $2$ have multiplicity $1$; $-1$ has multiplicity $2$.

steps.title: Use the graph behavior
steps.body: The leading term is $x^4$, so both ends rise. The graph crosses at the simple zeros and touches at the double zero.

steps.title: Determine interval signs
steps.body: Moving left from the rightmost positive interval, the sign reverses at $2$, stays negative at $-1$, and reverses at $-3$. From left to right: $+,-,-,+$.

steps.title: Exclude every zero
steps.body: Choose the two intervals below the axis. The strict inequality excludes $-3,-1,2$, including the double zero between two negative intervals.

steps.title: 找临界点
steps.body: $-2$ 是二重根，$0$ 和 $1$ 是一重根。

steps.title: 判断符号变化
steps.body: 首项 $x^4$ 给出最右段为正；跨过 $1$、$0$ 各换一次号，跨过 $-2$ 不换号。因此从左到右为 $+,+,-,+$。

steps.title: 选择正号
steps.body: 选三段正号，严格不等式排除全部零点，必须把 $-2$ 单独挖掉。

steps.title: Find the boundary points
steps.body: $-2$ is a double zero; $0$ and $1$ are simple zeros.

steps.title: Track the sign changes
steps.body: The leading term $x^4$ makes the rightmost sign positive. The sign reverses at $1$ and $0$, but not at $-2$. Left to right: $+,+,-,+$.

steps.title: Select the positive intervals
steps.body: Choose the three positive intervals. Exclude every zero, leaving a gap at $-2$ even though the signs on both sides are positive.

questions.label: 教材 Example 3：始终为正的因子

steps.title: 识别恒正因子
steps.body: $x^2+2\ge2>0$，没有实数零点，不改变其余因子的符号。

steps.title: 找实数临界点
steps.body: 只有 $x=-1,1$，划分三段。

steps.title: 选非正区间
steps.body: 中间一段为负；$\le0$ 允许等号，加入两端 $-1$ 和 $1$。

en.label: Textbook Example 3: Using Test Points to Solve a Polynomial Inequality

steps.title: Identify the positive factor
steps.body: $x^2+2\ge2>0$ has no real zeros and does not change the sign of the other factors.

steps.title: Find real boundaries
steps.body: Only $x=-1,1$ are real boundary points, forming three intervals.

steps.title: Test signs
steps.body: At $x=-2,0,2$, the original expression has values $18,-2,18$. The signs are $+,-,+$.

steps.title: Select the nonpositive interval
steps.body: The middle interval is negative. Include both endpoints because equality is allowed.

steps.title: 化为符号比较
steps.body: 原式与 $x(x-2)$ 同号，临界点为 $0,2$。

steps.title: 选非负区间
steps.body: 选两侧正号并加入零点 $0,2$。

steps.title: Complete the square
steps.body: $x^2+2x+2=(x+1)^2+1>0$ for every real $x$.

steps.title: Reduce the sign comparison
steps.body: The original expression has the same sign as $x(x-2)$. Its real boundary points are $0,2$.

steps.title: Test signs
steps.body: At $x=-1,1,3$, the original values are $3,-5,51$, giving signs $+,-,+$.

steps.title: Select the nonnegative set
steps.body: Choose the positive outer intervals and include $0$ and $2$.

questions.label: 教材 Example 4：两个分式比较

steps.title: 记录限制并归零
steps.body: $x\ne1,2$。左侧减右侧：$\dfrac{2}{x-1}-\dfrac{1}{x-2}\ge0$。

steps.title: 分出四段
steps.body: 临界点为 $1,2,3$：$1,2$ 是禁止点；$3$ 是可以满足等号的分子零点。

en.label: Textbook Example 4: Solve a Rational Inequality
en.prompt: Solve: $\dfrac{2}{x-1}\ge\dfrac{1}{x-2}$.

steps.title: Restrict the domain and subtract
steps.body: $x\ne1,2$. Write $\dfrac{2}{x-1}-\dfrac{1}{x-2}\ge0$.

steps.title: Identify boundary types
steps.body: The boundaries are $1,2,3$. Values $1,2$ are excluded denominator zeros; $3$ is a numerator zero where equality is possible.

steps.title: Determine the signs
steps.body: At $x=0,3/2,5/2,4$, the values are $-3/2,6,-2/3,1/6$, giving $-,+,-,+$. The polynomial $(x-3)(x-1)(x-2)$ gives the same signs away from the excluded points.

steps.title: Select the nonnegative intervals
steps.body: Choose $(1,2)$ and $(3,\infty)$. Include $3$ and continue to exclude $1,2$.

steps.title: 记录限制并归零
steps.body: $x\ne0,4$；写成 $\dfrac{3}{x}-\dfrac{1}{x-4}\le0$。

steps.title: 找临界点
steps.body: $0,4$ 是分母零点，$6$ 是分子零点。

steps.title: 选非正区间
steps.body: 保留两段负号，加入 $6$，排除 $0,4$。

en.label: Textbook Practice Problem 4
en.prompt: Solve: $\dfrac{3}{x}\le\dfrac{1}{x-4}$.

steps.title: Restrict the domain and subtract
steps.body: $x\ne0,4$. Write $\dfrac{3}{x}-\dfrac{1}{x-4}\le0$.

steps.title: Find boundary points
steps.body: $0,4$ are denominator zeros; $6$ is the numerator zero.

steps.title: Select the nonpositive set
steps.body: Choose the two negative intervals, include $6$, and exclude $0,4$.

questions.label: 教材 Example 5：分式与常数比较

steps.title: 记录限制并归零
steps.body: $x\ne-2$；减去 $4$，不要直接乘以可能为负的 $x+2$。

steps.title: 确定临界点
steps.body: $-2$ 是分母禁止点，$1$ 是分子零点；形成三段。

steps.title: 用图像或测试判号
steps.body: 同号多项式 $-3(x-1)(x+2)$ 是开口向下的抛物线，两根之间为正。也可测试 $x=-3,0,2$，得到 $-12,3/2,-3/4$。

steps.title: 选择严格正号
steps.body: 只取 $-2$ 与 $1$ 之间；分母限制和严格不等式都要求端点不加入。

en.label: Textbook Example 5: Using Graphs to Solve a Rational Inequality
en.prompt: Solve: $\dfrac{x+11}{x+2}>4$.

steps.title: Restrict the domain and subtract
steps.body: $x\ne-2$. Subtract $4$; do not multiply by $x+2$ without knowing its sign.

steps.title: Find boundary points
steps.body: $-2$ is an excluded denominator zero; $1$ is the numerator zero. They form three intervals.

steps.title: Use a graph or test points
steps.body: The same-sign polynomial $-3(x-1)(x+2)$ is a downward-opening parabola, positive between its roots. Testing $x=-3,0,2$ gives $-12,3/2,-3/4$.

steps.title: Select the strictly positive interval
steps.body: Choose the interval between $-2$ and $1$. Exclude $-2$ by the domain restriction and $1$ because the inequality is strict.

steps.title: 选择负号
steps.body: 只有中间区间为负；排除分母零点 $-3$，严格不等式排除分子零点 $2$。

en.label: Textbook Practice Problem 5
en.prompt: Solve: $\dfrac{5(x+1)}{x+3}<3$.

steps.title: Test the intervals
steps.body: The boundaries are $-3,2$. At $x=-4,0,3$, the values are $12,-4/3,1/3$, giving signs $+,-,+$.

steps.title: Select the negative interval
steps.body: Only the middle interval is negative. Exclude $-3$ because it is outside the domain, and exclude $2$ because the inequality is strict.

questions.label: 教材 Example 6：重复分母因子

steps.title: 记录定义域
steps.body: 原分母为零时 $x=-3,2$，两点永远排除。

steps.title: 列临界点并分段
steps.body: 分子零点是 $0,1$；全部临界点按序为 $-3,0,1,2$，形成五段。

steps.title: 解释不变号
steps.body: 分母中的 $(x+3)^2$ 是偶数次因子；跨过 $-3$ 不变号，但该点仍不属于定义域。

steps.title: 选负号并处理端点
steps.body: 选前三段中的两段负号和 $(1,2)$；$\le0$ 加入 $0,1$，排除 $-3,2$。

en.label: Textbook Example 6: Using Test Points to Solve a Rational Inequality

steps.title: Record the domain
steps.body: The original denominator vanishes at $x=-3,2$. Both are always excluded.

steps.title: Order all boundaries
steps.body: The numerator zeros are $0,1$. Boundaries $-3,0,1,2$ divide the line into five intervals.

steps.title: Explain the repeated factor
steps.body: The even power $(x+3)^2$ does not reverse the sign at $-3$, but $-3$ is still excluded from the domain.

steps.title: Select intervals and endpoints
steps.body: Choose the negative intervals. Include $0,1$ because equality is allowed; exclude $-3,2$ because they are denominator zeros.

steps.title: 排列临界点
steps.body: 按序为 $-3,-2,0,1$，形成五段；跨过二重根 $-2$ 不变号。

steps.title: 选非负并合并
steps.body: 保留正号段，加入有定义的零点 $-2,0$。因为 $-2$ 可以加入，其两侧可合并为 $(-3,0]$；仍排除 $-3,1$。

steps.title: Record the domain and zeros
steps.body: $x\ne-3,1$. The numerator zeros are $-2$ (double) and $0$ (simple).

steps.title: Order the boundary points
steps.body: Boundaries $-3,-2,0,1$ form five intervals. The sign does not change at the double zero $-2$.

steps.title: Select and combine
steps.body: Choose positive intervals and include the defined zeros $-2,0$. Including $-2$ combines its neighboring positive intervals into $(-3,0]$. Continue to exclude $-3,1$.

steps.title: Find a counterexample

steps.title: Compare both sides

steps.title: Find a counterexample

steps.title: Compare both sides
steps.body: For $x\ne1$, the squared denominator is positive, so the function is positive on both sides.

steps.body: Four decks contain 208 cards and 64 target cards. There must be a next card, so $0\le x<208$.

steps.title: Check actual card counts
steps.body: The algebraic model gives $400/3<x<208$. If 20% is exact, remaining target cards cannot exceed remaining cards: $64-0.2x\le208-x$, so $x\le180$. Also $x/5$ must be an integer.

steps.title: Compare at the same intensity
steps.body: Require $P_A(I)-P_B(I)>0$, with $I\ge0$.

steps.title: Combine into one fraction
steps.body: $P_A-P_B=I(I-4)/[(I+5)(I+2)]$. The denominator is positive throughout the physical domain.

steps.title: Check the numerator

en.answer: Species A is more effective when $I>4$.

steps.title: Keep the denominator exclusion
steps.body: The original expression always requires $x\ne1$, for every value of $a$.

steps.title: a less than 1
steps.body: The zero $a$ lies left of excluded value 1. The signs are $+,-,+$, giving $(-\infty,a]\cup(1,\infty)$.

steps.title: a equals 1
steps.body: The quotient simplifies to 1 only for $x\ne1$. The solution is $(-\infty,1)\cup(1,\infty)$.

steps.title: a greater than 1
steps.body: Excluded value 1 lies left of the zero $a$. The solution is $(-\infty,1)\cup[a,\infty)$.

exercises.prompt: 当参数 $a$ 变化时，描述 $(x-a)(x+1)(x-1)\ge0$ 的解集如何变化。

steps.title: 按a与两个固定零点比较
三个零点互不相同时
steps.body: 正首项三次式从左到右符号 $-,+,-,+$。因此：$a<-1$ 时为 $[a,-1]\cup[1,\infty)$；$-1<a<1$ 时为 $[-1,a]\cup[1,\infty)$；$a>1$ 时为 $[-1,1]\cup[a,\infty)$。

steps.title: a等于负1
steps.body: 式子变为 $(x+1)^2(x-1)\ge0$。$x=-1$ 是孤立零点，其他满足值为 $x\ge1$；解为 $\{-1\}\cup[1,\infty)$。

steps.title: a等于1
steps.body: 式子变为 $(x-1)^2(x+1)\ge0$；在 $x\ge-1$ 非负，故解为 $[-1,\infty)$。

en.prompt: Describe how the solution set of $(x-a)(x+1)(x-1)\ge0$ changes as the number $a$ changes.

steps.title: Compare with both fixed zeros
steps.body: The fixed zeros are $-1,1$. Separate $a<-1$, $a=-1$, $-1<a<1$, $a=1$, and $a>1$.

steps.title: Three distinct zeros
steps.body: A cubic with positive leading coefficient has signs $-,+,-,+$. Thus: for $a<-1$, $[a,-1]\cup[1,\infty)$; for $-1<a<1$, $[-1,a]\cup[1,\infty)$; for $a>1$, $[-1,1]\cup[a,\infty)$.

steps.title: a equals negative 1
steps.body: The inequality becomes $(x+1)^2(x-1)\ge0$. The zero at $-1$ is isolated; all other solutions satisfy $x\ge1$. The solution is $\{-1\}\cup[1,\infty)$.

steps.title: a equals 1
steps.body: The expression is $(x-1)^2(x+1)\ge0$, nonnegative for $x\ge-1$. The solution is $[-1,\infty)$.

exercises.prompt: 当参数 $a$ 变化时，描述 $(x-a)/[(x-1)(x+1)]\ge0$ 的解集如何变化。

steps.title: 固定原式禁值
steps.body: 所有情形都要求 $x\ne-1,1$。即使 $a=\pm1$ 可以约分，这两个禁值仍保留。

steps.title: a等于负1
steps.body: 原式在允许的点化为 $1/(x-1)\ge0$；只有 $x>1$ 满足。

steps.title: a等于1
steps.body: 原式在允许的点化为 $1/(x+1)\ge0$，要求 $x>-1$ 且 $x\ne1$；解为 $(-1,1)\cup(1,\infty)$。

en.prompt: Describe how the solution set of $(x-a)/[(x-1)(x+1)]\ge0$ changes as the number $a$ changes.

steps.title: Keep original exclusions
steps.body: Always require $x\ne-1,1$. These exclusions remain even when $a=\pm1$ allows cancellation.

steps.title: Three distinct critical numbers
steps.body: Each numerator or denominator factor has degree one, giving signs $-,+,-,+$ after ordering. For $a<-1$: $[a,-1)\cup(1,\infty)$; for $-1<a<1$: $(-1,a]\cup(1,\infty)$; for $a>1$: $(-1,1)\cup[a,\infty)$.

steps.title: a equals negative 1
steps.body: At allowed points the inequality becomes $1/(x-1)\ge0$, which holds only for $x>1$.

steps.title: a equals 1
steps.body: At allowed points it becomes $1/(x+1)\ge0$, requiring $x>-1$ and $x\ne1$. The solution is $(-1,1)\cup(1,\infty)$.

exercises.prompt: 若 $P(x)>0$ 的解集包含 $k$ 个形如 $(a,b)$ 的开区间和一个形如 $(c,\infty)$ 的区间，可以对多项式 $P$ 的次数作何判断？

steps.title: 先明确“区间”的含义
steps.body: 通常把题中区间理解为解集的不同最大连通区间，而不是任意选的子区间。若仅指“包含任意子区间”，正的常数多项式也能满足，不能推得次数下界。

steps.title: 数端点并考虑重数
steps.body: 每个有界正区间有两个有限端点，它们必为零点。若相邻两个正区间共享一个零点，该点两边都为正，所以必须是至少二重根；按重数计仍提供两个端点。

steps.title: 加上右侧区间的端点
steps.body: 右侧区间 $(c,\infty)$ 再贡献一个有限端点。故零点按重数至少共 $2k+1$ 个，$\deg P\ge2k+1$。若 $c$ 与一个有界区间共享端点，则该根至少二重，同样成立。

steps.title: 不要额外断言奇偶
steps.body: “包含”并未排除左侧也有正区间，所以次数可为偶数。例如 $(x^2-1)^2>0$ 有1个有界正区间及右侧正区间，却是4次。只有另知这些是全部正区间、且左端为负，才可断言正首项奇数次。

exercises.answer: 按最大解区间理解：$\deg P\ge2k+1$；仅凭“包含”不能确定次数奇偶。若仅是任意子区间，则无次数下界。

en.prompt: If the solution set of the polynomial inequality $P(x)>0$ contains $k$ open intervals of the form $(a,b)$ and one interval of the form $(c,\infty)$, what can be said about the degree of the polynomial $P$?

steps.title: Clarify what interval means
steps.body: Interpret the stated intervals as distinct maximal connected intervals of the solution set. If they are merely arbitrary subintervals, a positive constant already contains them and no degree lower bound follows.

steps.title: Count endpoints with multiplicity
steps.body: Each bounded positive component has two finite endpoints, both zeros. If neighboring positive components share a zero, the sign is positive on both sides, so the zero has even multiplicity at least two. Counting multiplicity still counts both endpoints.

steps.title: Count the ray’s finite endpoint
steps.body: The right-hand component $(c,\infty)$ contributes one finite endpoint. Thus the zeros counted with multiplicity total at least $2k+1$, so $\deg P\ge2k+1$. If $c$ is shared with a bounded component, its multiplicity is at least two, preserving the count.

steps.title: Avoid an unsupported parity claim
steps.body: The wording does not rule out a positive left-hand tail, so even degrees are possible. For example, $(x^2-1)^2>0$ has one bounded positive component and a positive right tail, but degree four. Odd degree with a positive leading coefficient follows only if these are all positive components and the left tail is negative.

en.answer: For maximal solution components: $\deg P\ge2k+1$; the stated containment alone does not determine parity. For arbitrary subintervals, no degree lower bound follows.

exercises.prompt: 若 $P(x)<0$ 的解集包含 $k$ 个形如 $(a,b)$ 的开区间，可以对多项式 $P$ 的次数作何判断？

steps.title: 把区间视为不同最大解区间
steps.body: 通常按解集的 $k$ 个有界连通区间理解。若只是任意子区间，负常数多项式也包含任意多个，不能推出次数下界。

steps.title: 按重数数端点
steps.body: 每个有界负区间需要两个有限零点端点。相邻负区间若共享一个零点，因两侧同负，该零点至少为二重根。因此按重数至少有 $2k$ 个零点。

steps.title: 得出下界并检查奇偶
steps.body: 所以 $\deg P\ge2k$。题目未排除负的无界区间，故不能断言次数为偶数。$x(x-1)(x-2)<0$ 有有界区间 $(1,2)$，同时还有 $(-\infty,0)$，次数是3。

steps.title: 如果这些是全部负区间
steps.body: 若另知解集恰好只有这 $k$ 个有界区间，则两侧最终为正，$P$ 必为正首项偶数次，次数仍至少 $2k$。

exercises.answer: 按最大解区间理解：$\deg P\ge2k$；“包含”不足以确定次数奇偶。若仅指任意子区间，则无次数下界。

en.prompt: If the solution set of the polynomial inequality $P(x)<0$ contains $k$ open intervals of the form $(a,b)$, what can be said about the degree of the polynomial $P$?

steps.title: Use maximal solution intervals
steps.body: Interpret these as $k$ distinct bounded connected components of the solution set. If they are arbitrary subintervals, a negative constant contains any number of them and no degree bound follows.

steps.title: Count endpoints with multiplicity
steps.body: Each bounded negative component needs two finite zero endpoints. If neighboring negative components share a zero, the sign is negative on both sides, so that zero has multiplicity at least two. The total zero multiplicity is therefore at least $2k$.

steps.title: State the bound and check parity
steps.body: Thus $\deg P\ge2k$. Negative unbounded components are not ruled out, so parity is not fixed. For example, $x(x-1)(x-2)<0$ has bounded component $(1,2)$ and also $(-\infty,0)$, while its degree is three.

steps.title: If these are all negative components
steps.body: If the full solution consists exactly of these $k$ bounded components, both tails are positive; then $P$ has even degree and a positive leading coefficient, still with degree at least $2k$.

en.answer: For maximal solution components: $\deg P\ge2k$; containment does not determine parity. For arbitrary subintervals, no degree lower bound follows.
